name: Vampire Soldier Character Production
description: Vampire Soldier's independent Darkstalkers-sequel profile. It separates foundation-complete conversion validity from final DS4 design completion and does not inherit the DS crossover roster or Street Fighter reimagining rubric.

phases.name: Foundation-complete / conversion-valid
phases.summary: Verify Vampire Savior-derived behavior and the current technical foundation without claiming final sequel completion.

steps.label: Applicable Vampire Savior Foundation v1 behavior, evidence, supported cases, and known gaps are identified
Reusable technical foundation is integrated without importing DS crossover policy
Current behavior is compared and tested against every declared DS4 deviation
Unresolved sequel direction is recorded as design debt or an open decision
Record explicitly says Foundation-complete / conversion-valid and not final completion

phases.name: DS4 design-complete
phases.summary: Complete the approved sequel design and review the character against the finished DS4 ruleset.

steps.label: JustNoPoint has approved every applicable sequel system and character decision
All approved DS4 deviations affecting this character are implemented
Avatar-influenced concepts have documented purpose and coherent Darkstalkers fit
Character passes review and testing against the complete DS4 ruleset
Later approved DS4 rules have reopened and revalidated every affected gate
JustNoPoint explicitly signs off DS4 design-complete status

phases.name: Provisional DS4-first character origin
phases.summary: When scheduling selects this route, preserve portable identity/content while isolating DS4 sequel implementation.

steps.label: JustNoPoint approves DS4-first scheduling for this character; Anita and Rever remain provisional candidates
Source-neutral concept, research, visual/audio assets, move intent, and character goals are versioned where practical
DS4 states, constants, effects, sounds, metadata, controls, resources, tests, and balance remain game-owned
Port-difference record tracks DS4-only decisions, retained behavior, assets, and unresolved questions
Any later transfer uses a reviewed patch or versioned snapshot without live cross-project references
Later changes are classified before propagation as character-neutral, shared-mechanism, or game-specific
